name: hrm-attendance
description: HRM Chấm công — Monorepo (BE: Express + SQLite, FE: React + Vite)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BE,FE -c blue,green "npm:dev:be" "node scripts/wait-for-be.mjs && npm run dev:fe"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix attendance-web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix attendance-web
